rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: ~ subject + condition in DESeq2 with the Wald test on the condition coefficient, an edgeR QL cross-check on the same blocked design, and an explicit statement that no per-subject test is possible with one sample per subject per condition. QC uses blind VST, PCA, sample distances and library sizes coloured by subject and condition, with pairing verification and a named-but-not-dropped outlier policy, though no explicit rule for a shallow library is given. Filtering (>=10 counts in 5 samples), in-model normalization, an explicitly set reference level, the named contrast triple, BH at 0.05, apeglm shrinkage, and lfcThreshold-in-results are all stated. Enrichment was not requested but is executed correctly (full Wald-stat ranking, named collection and version, 15–500 size window, tested-gene universe for any ORA); the report step lists method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE counts, and design caveats.
